subject.title: Doubao: query Coding/Agent Plan usage via arkcli CLI

question: When Doubao auto mode has both configured API credentials and an authenticated arkcli SSO session, which account source should take precedence?
rationale: Both paths are valid but may represent different accounts, and the choice changes existing users’ effective account and error visibility; code review cannot safely choose that product policy without repository-owner intent.

options.title: Honor configured credentials
options.body: Use configured AK/SK or bearer credentials as the authoritative account in auto mode, falling back to arkcli only when no account-specific credentials are configured.

options.title: Prefer arkcli SSO
options.body: Keep arkcli first, but explicitly approve the upgrade behavior and add visible source/account disclosure so users can detect an identity change.

options.title: Require explicit source selection
options.body: Avoid mixed-source auto routing and require users with multiple available identities to choose cli or api in settings.

recommendation.title: Honor configured credentials
recommendation.body: Use configured AK/SK or bearer credentials as the authoritative account in auto mode, falling back to arkcli only when no account-specific credentials are configured.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a repository-wide provider UX and backward-compatibility policy choice for the default source mode.
